method: Whole-file manual reading of RecoveryFat.h/cpp,691 lines; pinned bytes verified. No raw disk or recovery execution.
findings: Boot parser derives FAT12/16/32 from cluster count, validates jump/signature, power-of-two sectors/clusters, <=64KiB clusters, metadata/data bounds, FAT capacity and active/mirrored configuration. Filesystem label is not authoritative.

FAT page cache includes overlap bytes for packed FAT12 entries crossing64KiB boundaries. Mirrored copies must match for queried entry; differing copies fail rather than choose one. This is not full-volume mirror equality verification.

Chain traversal validates cluster range, rejects revisits with a set and rejects reserved/bad/free links before end marker. Scan uses explicit directory stack and global visited clusters to reject overlapping directory chains. Memory can grow with traversed clusters; no hard budget established.

Long-name assembly checks ordinal/checksum/type/cluster/padding and UTF16 validity. Deleted ordinals and first short-name byte are reconstructed from checksum; fallback short names use OEM code page and erased initial underscore. No host-portable Unicode runtime qualification.

Only deleted nondirectory candidates from allocated directory trees are published. Deleted directories are not traversed, and erased file chains are approximated by consecutive free clusters. Therefore fragmented deleted-file recovery is not established by free-allocation checks.

Validation rereads boot except dirty-state byte, containing-directory chain, exact saved directory fragments and allocation. Copy checks fresh allocation before/after each chunk and metadata before/after final flush. These checks do not freeze free-cluster contents or establish original file bytes.

Scan retains valid candidates while counting invalid directory/entry records, propagates cancellation and non-invalid-data I/O failures. Discovered callback occurs before final Recycle Bin name resolution, so streaming names can differ from final results.

RecoveryFile does not itself compare source volume identity with canonical destination in this implementation. Same-volume confirmation policy, if any, requires dialog review. No destructive action executed.
limits: No synthetic FAT image parser harness, malformed-volume tests, fragmented-file oracle, source mutation, real disk read or recovered output performed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
